posts.name: Envisioner
posts.cooked:
I just started not having an Edit button on any of my posts, though I can still make new posts.  A thing appeared in the upper left of my screen, and when I clicked on it, it expanded and I copied this gibberish out of it:

 

Authcache Debug

StatusCache Status: "Caching CANCELED"
Message 1: "Canceled: No client for fragment form-token"
Page Render Time: "2169.62 ms"
Page Age: "-816 seconds"

SettingsCache Class: "MemCacheDrupal"
Cache CID: "8216a6c/forum/topic/incapacitation-too-powerful-4727"
Debug Users: ["joelr","cajunjoel"]
Cache User: "6982"
Cache Backends: "authcache_builtin"
Active Backend: "authcache_builtin"
Authcache Key: "8216a6c"
Key props: {"base_root":"https://greaterthangames.com","roles":[2]}

HTML/JavaScript time: 2060 ms

 

Anyone else having an issue?

 

EDIT - Okay, ironically, I now have an Edit button.  But not a Reply button, not that I used this much.

EDIT 2 - Problem appears to be completely fixed, except that I'm still getting the Application Debug thing in the corner.
